page_title: MAL 1-1 VIL | Mallorca v Villarreal 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the top left corner is stopped by Arnau Tenas, who pulls off a glorious save!
90+4' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Dani Parejo (Villarreal). Mallorca are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+1' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:4. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 16:12.
90' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Georges Mikautadze.
89' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) misses a huge chance from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
88' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

87' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
86' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Victor Garcia blows for a foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
85' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

81' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top right corner. His long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
81' Corner kick. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is ready to send the ball into the box.
80' Samu Costa (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Mallorca have a corner.
79' Leo Roman leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:5. The shots on goal statistics – 6:2.
76' Problems for Martin Demichelis as Pablo Torre is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and David Lopez (Mallorca) replaces him.
75' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) replaces Santi Comesana.
75' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' The resulting corner from Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is cleared.
71' Samu Costa (Mallorca) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card. Samu Costa (Mallorca) will miss the next game.
71' The referee signals a substitution. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Tajon Buchanan.
70' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ayoze Perez limps off the pitch to be replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal).
70' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is being substituted because of an injury. Martin Demichelis sends Miguel Calatayud on the pitch.
70' Martin Demichelis prepares a substitution. Manu Morlanes is replaced by Jan Virgili (Mallorca).
69' The cross into the penalty area from Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
68' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.

65' Samu Costa (Mallorca) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.s a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score doesn't change.
63' That will be all from Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
63' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alfonso Gonzalez will be replaced by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal).
62' Martin Demichelis is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Johan Mojica (Mallorca) suffers an injury and Toni Lato comes on.
60' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
59' The game is interrupted now, Johan Mojica (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

58' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
56' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Arnau Tenas is alert and makes a decent save.

55' This was a nice set play that lacked a finish. Unmarked Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick and unleashed a long-range shot. He hit the ball very poorly, sending it into the stands.
55' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) will deliver the corner kick.
54' The ball is cleared after Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
54' A pass from Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is intercepted by Arnau Tenas and the move breaks down.
54' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Johan Mojica, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
53' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is cleared to safety by the defence.
52' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
52' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
50' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Leo Roman.
47' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Victor Garcia sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+4' The Mallorca players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Arnau Tenas and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.
45+2' Samu Costa (Mallorca) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
45+2' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Samu Costa (Mallorca) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
38' Samu Costa (Mallorca) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Arnau Tenas.
37' The corner kick is deflected to Omar Mascarell (Mallorca), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
37' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

37' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the right side of the goal lacks power and Arnau Tenas easily makes the save. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
36' Alfonso Gonzalez receives a sweet pass inside the box from Sergi Cardona (Villarreal), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
35' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
34' The attendance is 19663.
34' Samu Costa (Mallorca) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Zito Luvumbo, but Arnau Tenas displays great awareness to stop him.
32' 3:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Leo Roman gets a hand on the penalty from Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
31' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
30' The Villarreal players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
30' Referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Villarreal. Let’s see what happens!

29' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. That looked a certain handball by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

28' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle. Villarreal will take a free kick.
27' A pass by Thomas Partey (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Mallorca.
25' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
25' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Tajon Buchanan wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
24' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
23' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) brings an opponent down and Victor Garcia interrupts the game. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
21' Samu Costa (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
20' Vedat Muriqi almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
18' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
17' Samu Costa dinks a cheeky lofted pass into Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca), but his headed effort from near the penalty spot goes narrowly wide of the left post.
16' 52:48 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) swings it in and Samu Costa gets on the end of it, but Arnau Tenas shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
12' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
8' Samu Costa (Mallorca) tries to find Mateu Morey Bauza, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
7' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

6' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Mallorca are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
5' Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Mallorca.
4' Neat passing move from Villarreal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
1' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.

Mallorca will kick-off.
